Alternatively, those with 2 years of premedical education in the US/Canada, who studied at a WHO-recognized school, completed all formal requirements for the MD degree (except internship/social service), completed 1 year of supervised clinical training at a US/Canadian medical school, and completed 1 year of graduate medical education approved by the Liaison Committee on Graduate Medical Education of the AMA, may be admitted to the licensure examination without the ECFMG certificate.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Telehealth includes synchronous or asynchronous audio, video, electronic media or other telecommunications technology for evaluating, diagnosing, consulting, prescribing, treating or monitoring patients. Physicians may obtain proxy credentialing and privileging for telehealth services with other health care providers or facilities complying with CMS conditions of participation.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: ''telehealth'' shall mean the use of synchronous or asynchronous audio, video, electronic media or other telecommunications technology, including, but not limited to: (i) interactive audio-video technology; (ii) remote patient monitoring devices; (iii) audio-only telephone; and (iv) online adaptive interviews, for the purpose of evaluating, diagnosing, consulting, prescribing, treating or monitoring of a patient's physical health
